CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kumeel_is_secure_editor()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.kumeel_has_active_session()
 and (select auth.jwt()->>'aal')='aal2'
 and exists(select 1 from public.kumeel_editors e join auth.users u on u.id=e.user_id
 where u.id=(select auth.uid()) and u.email_confirmed_at is not null
 and lower(u.email) in ('komeil9060@gmail.com','bobmorgann2@gmail.com'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION kumeel_private.valid_sparring_turns(t jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when t is null or jsonb_typeof(t)<>'array' then false
 when jsonb_array_length(t)>40 then false
 else not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(t) e where
  case when jsonb_typeof(e)<>'object' then true
  else exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(e) k where k not in ('role','text','quote'))
   or coalesce(e->>'role','') not in ('critic','owner')
   or case when jsonb_typeof(e->'text') is distinct from 'string' then true else char_length(e->>'text') not between 1 and 4000 end
   or case when not (e ? 'quote') then false when jsonb_typeof(e->'quote')<>'string' then true else char_length(e->>'quote')>500 end
  end)
 end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kumeel_delete_sparring(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not public.kumeel_is_secure_editor() then raise exception 'COMMUNITY_FORBIDDEN' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 delete from public.kumeel_sparring where id=p_id;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kumeel_has_active_session()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from auth.sessions s where s.user_id=(select auth.uid())
  and s.id::text=(select auth.jwt()->>'session_id') and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>now()));
$function$
